title: 人鱼‘王子’
slug: 豪门情变前夫过期不候全本免费-豪门情变前夫过期不候最新章节列表
content_zh:
心语只觉跳动的心瞬间停掉，手机无力滑落，心开始一阵阵发寒，寒得生出缕缕生疼的意味。
一片镁光灯里，她不敢抬头，她可以想象自己有多狼狈，很想哭，却发现泪像流干了似的怎么也哭不出来，好难受。
不远处，黑色宾利稳固地盘踞着，车内，男子目光落到窗外，一片清冷。
车门猛地被推开。
“大少！”程进抢先一步下车挡在顾天承面前，“您不能去！”
“让开！”短促有力，不容抗拒。
程进咬牙，“您这个时候出现，只会火上浇油！那边……您不用太担心，我已经报警了，警察马上会来处理！”
他薄唇紧抿着，下颚略微向内收紧，隐晦的薄怒似乎一触即发。
所幸警察的办事效率还算高，很快赶到现场清理走记者，程进暗暗松了口气，他跟着顾天承这么多年，深知，他要做的事没人能拦得住。
顾天承下车到驾驶座，淡淡地交待了一句，“不用跟着我！”启动车子。
程进看着车子巡着颜心语的方向开去，无奈叹息。
‘雨下在我窗前，玻璃也在流眼泪，街上的人都看起来，比我幸福一点，用寂寞来测验，还是最想要你陪……’车内放的歌很好听，和着雨丝，打在耳畔。
心语在车厢蜷缩成一团，整个人还是恍惚的，警察替她叫的出租车。
车停下，心语像木偶般直直下来，抬眸，‘嫣语园’眨眼，羽睫上附的薄薄一层雨水，顺着长睫轻轻滑落。
这里是她唯一的‘避难所’，她就像驼鸟，伤心的时候只想找个地方躲起来，不让任何人找到。她痴痴地往里走，一草一木，亭台楼阁都分外的熟悉，甚至触手可及的绿色，都葱郁欲滴，不由得想起十六岁那年……如果那个时候她没有失足落水，如果救她的不是顾少卿，如果那个情窦初开的年龄，她没有遇到那样美好的他，没有……爱上他，该有多好！
天空，乌云低低坠在天际，摇摇晃晃，好似随时都会塌下来一样。
她凄然的背影，仿佛落叶丛中偶有小小的白色花，纤弱得一阵风都将它能断绝。
顾天承清冷的目光穿透薄薄的雨雾落在她身上，深邃的眼神杂糅进太多复杂，薄唇抿紧，她还记得这里！
那一次，他救起落水的她，莫名的就见过最美的新娘，新郎却是他弟弟顾少卿……

content_en:
Xinyu felt that her beating heart stopped momentarily, her cell phone slipped down weakly, and her heart began to feel cold, so cold that it felt like she was in pain.
In the spotlight, she didn't dare to look up. She could imagine how embarrassed she was and wanted to cry, but she found that her tears seemed to have dried up and she couldn't cry anymore. It was so uncomfortable.
Not far away, a black Bentley was entrenched firmly. Inside the car, the man's eyes fell out of the window, and everything was deserted.
The car door was pushed open suddenly.
"Young Master!" Cheng Jin got out of the car first and stood in front of Gu Tiancheng, "You can't go!"
"Get out of the way!" The words were short and powerful, irresistible.
Cheng Jin gritted his teeth, "Your appearance at this time will only add fuel to the fire! Over there... you don't have to worry too much, I have already called the police, and the police will deal with it soon!"
His thin lips were pursed tightly, his jaw was slightly pulled inward, and his hidden anger seemed to be on the verge of breaking out.
Fortunately, the police were very efficient and quickly rushed to the scene to clear away the reporters. Cheng Jin secretly breathed a sigh of relief. He had followed Gu Tiancheng for so many years and knew that no one could stop him from what he wanted to do.
Gu Tiancheng got out of the car and got to the driver's seat, and said calmly, "No need to follow me!" and started the car.
Cheng Jin watched the car driving in the direction of Yan Xinyu and sighed helplessly.
"The rain is falling in front of my window, and the glass is weeping. The people on the street seem to be a little happier than me. As a test of loneliness, I still want you to accompany me the most..." The song playing in the car is very nice, playing with the rain, playing in my ears.
Xinyu huddled up in a ball in the carriage, still in a daze, and the police called a taxi for her.
The car stopped, Xinyu straightened down like a puppet, raised his eyes, 'Yan Yuyuan' blinked, and the thin layer of rain on the eyelashes slid gently along the long eyelashes.
This is her only 'shelter'. She is like an ostrich. When she is sad, she just wants to find a place to hide and not let anyone find her. She walked inwardly, and every plant and tree, the pavilions and pavilions were all very familiar, and even the greenery within her reach was lush and lush. She couldn't help but think of the time when she was sixteen... If she had not slipped and fallen into the water at that time, if it was not Gu Shaoqing who saved her, if at that age when her love was just beginning, she had not met such a beautiful him, and had not... fallen in love with him, how wonderful it would be!
In the sky, dark clouds hung low in the sky, swaying as if they would collapse at any time.
Her sad back was like a small white flower among the fallen leaves, so delicate that a gust of wind could cut it off.
Gu Tiancheng's cold eyes penetrated the thin rain and mist and fell on her. His deep eyes were filled with too much complexity. His thin lips were pursed. She still remembered this place!
That time, when he rescued her from falling into the water, he inexplicably saw the most beautiful bride he had ever seen, and the groom was his younger brother Gu Shaoqing...
